writing.exampleCaption: The unsafe block is small; the wrapper is where the rules live.
writing.explanation: extern "C" fixes the calling convention, repr(C) fixes the layout, and everything about ownership becomes a convention you have to document. Who frees this pointer, may it be null, how long is it valid, and is it aliased are the four questions each call has to answer — and the safe wrapper you write around it is where those answers are enforced.
